name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      node-version: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.node-version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: setup
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
          force-install: false

  lint:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.node-version }}
          cache: pnpm
          force-install: false
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.node-version }}
          cache: pnpm
          force-install: false
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm typecheck

  test:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.node-version }}
          cache: pnpm
          force-install: false
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

  dependency-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v4
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fail-on-severity: high
          fail-on-scopes: all
          base-ref: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          head-ref: ${{ github.head_ref }}

  codeql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          working-directory: .

  super-linter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: super-linter/super-linter/slim@v8.3.2
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
